title: Koraidon R SV5K 052/071 Wild Force Pokemon Card Japanese
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Koraidon R SV5K 052/071 Wild Force Pokemon Card Japanese is a must-have for any serious collector or fan of the Pokemon Trading Card Game. With its stunning altered art and holographic finish, this card is sure to impress and add a touch of excitement to any collection. 

Featuring the powerful grass-type creature Koraidon, this standard-sized card is made of high-quality paper and is suitable for ages 6 and up. Whether you are a seasoned collector or just starting out, this card is a great addition to any Pokemon TCG collection. Don't miss your chance to own this rare card from the Scarlet & Violet set.
